Title: Config loader with env secret override
Detail: Resolve config path (param/env/default), Import-PowerShellDataFile, override NagLight token from MCKEEPER_FEED_TOKEN, validate required keys, throw on missing.

Title: Structured console logger
Detail: Timestamped INFO/WARN/ERROR/OK lines shared by entry points.

Title: NagLight feeder client
Detail: POST {check,ok,note} to /api/feed with bearer token; -WhatIfPost prints payload without posting; never fabricates ok=true.

Title: Server-up probe
Detail: TCP connect with timeout; optional local java-process corroboration; returns Up + note.

Title: Paper version currency (v3 fill API)
Detail: Resolve active jar (START.bat then newest), parse version/build, query v3 builds, compare; any API error => Ok=false with note.

Title: Checker orchestrator
Detail: Run up-probe + version (+ optional plugins), report each to NagLight; failures post ok=false, never skipped.

Title: plugin.yml manifest reader
Detail: Open jar as zip read-only, read plugin.yml/paper-plugin.yml, grab name/version/api-version/authors/depend; note on parse failure.

Title: Plugin inventory + source mapping
Detail: Enumerate plugins/*.jar, map to fork (diytechy snapshot) + canonical (plugin-sources.psd1); emit redacted JSON+MD; 'unmapped' when unresolved.

Title: Update plan (Modrinth)
Detail: For each Modrinth-slugged plugin, query latest build for MC version+loaders, compare (build metadata stripped); fork/Hangar/Spigot/unmapped flagged for human.

Title: Staged verify + gated swap
Detail: Download to staging, verify sha512+manifest+api-version, produce swap plan; -Execute backs up old jar then installs, rollback on failure.

Title: Settings backup archiver
Detail: Copy config-extension files from root/config/plugins (skip bulky dirs), worlds behind -IncludeWorlds, zip to timestamped archive at BackupDest; ShouldProcess-gated write.

Title: Fork status detection
Detail: For fork-sourced plugins, query GitHub releases/latest + tags, classify status; read-only, never pushes; 'unknown' on failure.
